title: Chapter 162 Target Qingmu Village
content:
Chapter 162 Target Qingmu Village

On the way back to the lord's mansion, Xiao Laoteng found Wang Shuo. At this time, he had completely lost his previous arrogance.

"Lord, when is it convenient for you to arrange for the masons in your territory to learn to draw defensive runes?"

Wang Shuo slapped his forehead and apologized: "Master Architect, I'm sorry, I've been too busy recently, and I forgot to remind Duan Wenxi. It's my fault."

"It's okay, Lord, you are busy with all kinds of things, and my little thing won't get in the way!" Xiao Laoteng had already broken the jar and had no expression on his face.

"I'll arrange it right away, and I'll pay you the remaining balance first!" Wang Shuo walked over and settled the agreed amount of gold coins with energy crystals.

After leaving him alone for so long, Wang Shuo's resentment in his heart was almost gone.

"Thank you, Lord." At this time, Xiao Laoteng squeezed out a smile.

Meeting room.

"Gu Liji, tell me about the situation just now." Wang Shuo sat at the top of the hall and looked at Gu Liji and said lightly.

"Yes, Lord!"

"The head of Qingmu Village is called Zhang Wenlong, level 32, a military commander. According to my observation, he is probably already a mid-level military commander, and his strength is very strong."

"There are more than 300 people in the village, and the average level is around level 22..."

After listening to Guliji's report, Wang Shuo's heart sank. The strength of this Qingmu Village should not be underestimated!

"Everyone, do you have any suggestions?"

"Lord, with our current military strength, if we want to attack by force, I'm afraid the losses will be great!"

Bai Liliang stepped forward and said with some concern.

"I don't care. I should be able to hold off the so-called head for a long time!" Gong Zheng said indifferently and sniffed.

Wang Shuo turned to look at Ayub and pondered, "Does Abu have a plan?"

"I don't recommend a strong attack either. Our cavalry is not good at mountain warfare."

Wang Shuo fell into deep thought. In his heart, he asked Chang Gui, "Agui, do you have any plan?"

"Lord, since it is not appropriate to attack the mountain stronghold, then we can only lead them to a terrain that is conducive to our battle."

"We can do this,... this..."

Wang Shuo nodded without comment. It seems that this is the only way.

"Everyone rest for one night and set off tomorrow to flatten Qingmu Village." Wang Shuo said loudly to everyone.

"Yes, Lord."

Early in the morning of the second day, Wang Shuo first exchanged 50 A-level qualified tools at the resource exchange office and expanded them to the cavalry unit to complete the establishment of the entire unit.

The horse brand was just enough. He couldn't take back the ones he had issued to the militia before.

Wang Shuo gave the extra 20 soldiers to Gong Zheng to lead, so that they could form a shield unit in the future to serve as the backbone and withstand the attack of the enemy's frontal forces.

As for Baili Liang's troops, Wang Shuo named them the City Defense Army, which was temporarily responsible for defending the village.

Wang Shuo turned to Duan Wenxi and said, "When I'm not in the village, you have to organize people, survey the surrounding minerals, and find some work for Mira as soon as possible."

After instructing others to do their jobs and work hard.

Wang Shuo led more than 100 people including the Golden Fire Cavalry to the Wadang Mountain.

At the same time, Nanshanji also ushered in a huge change.

The friction between Ni Wu's Iron Sword Gate, Zhuge Kewei's Wild Wolf Gang, Yue Ji's Fiery Rose, and several other gangs continued to escalate, and they all wanted to become the most influential gangs in the town.

On this day, several troops set up their formations on an open ground outside Nanshanji, and a war was about to break out.
